why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Isaac Collins is slot #1 (4.467 expected team runs/game).
Slots #1, #2, #5, #4, #3, #6, #9, #8, #7 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #7 ranks 9 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.010 R/G.
Slot #1 yields 4.66 expected PA/game vs 4.01 at primary slot #7. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
